dev.devSubtitle: Turning ideas into actual performant interfaces.
dev.devDescription: I enjoy building modern web applications, focusing on clarity, accessibility and consistency. My client facing background helps me translate real user needs into simple flows and clean components. I care about naming, structure and patterns that make it easy for others to read and maintain the code.
dev.devTagline2: Making complex systems feel like a breeze.

coffee.coffeeDescPart1: Rocked the grinder behind the espresso machine, and brewed coffee for over a decade. Managed cafés in fast-paced environments, serving the people their daily dose of caffeine. Those years taught me to listen, understand needs quickly and simplify choices.
coffee.highlightCoffeeLine: I bring that same mindset into tech
coffee.coffeeDescPart2: focusing on a digital customer experience and building interfaces that feel as friendly and intuitive as a good coffee shop.

about.testimonials: Don't take my word for it

mission.title: MISSION
mission.description: a bold statement and one of my main goals. I enjoy creating software that is easy to use, intuitive and solve problems.
mission.content: Trained in front-end development, working my way across the full stack. With a solid background in human connection, structure and project management, I focus on delivering high-quality and make the complex simple.
mission.tagline2: Helping people to succeed with digital products.
